goal: A personal website for Sankalp Asawa, made only from what the internet says about me: IIT Roorkee, B.Tech and M.Tech, with a semester exchange at KTH in Stockholm; General Secretary Academics at IIT Roorkee and founder of its Student Mentorship Program; Goldman Sachs; Slice in Bengaluru, chief of staff to the COO and then to the CEO; the onRec IITR Offbeat episode 'Leading with a social cause'; on X as @SankalpAsawa. The internet also says Angel One, and a research profile at the University of Tokyo, and I am not sure those are right. Pages: About, Work, IIT Roorkee, Talks, Contact. Every line says where it came from.
why: founder 2026-09-29: 'Next simulation which I want to do is to create a personal website for Sankalp. Take all the data from the internet.' The person is the founder himself; the facts are the internet's, not the repo's; two of them are unsure on purpose, so the department has to ask before they go live (finding 7's flow); the run is the first on a Beta that carries the function chat (U1) and proves it by clicks.
